agent_resource.desc: Agent resource properties to set. Only provided fields are updated.

channel_id.desc: ID of the code channel to update.

code_channel.desc: Code channel properties to set. Only provided fields are updated.

status.desc: New status for the agent session. _Acceptable values:_ `active` `processing` `suspended` `closed`. The `status` and `title` arguments are being deprecated as part of the sessions API unification.

title.desc: New display title for the agent session. The `status` and `title` arguments are being deprecated as part of the sessions API unification.

desc: Set properties on a code channel.

errors.channel_not_found: The specified channel\_id does not correspond to a valid channel.
errors.invalid_status: Value passed for `status` was not a valid agent session status.
errors.no_properties_provided: At least one property field must be provided.
errors.not_agent_channel: The specified channel is not a code channel.
errors.not_authorized: The caller is not an authorized agent bot for this channel.
